about: The judges' page, /judges/, as one Task Object of words (the AgoraJudges board and backlog O11, November 1, 2026). Every row of 'What is real' is either filled at build time from a record this site holds (the 'fill' names which one: the replayed run, the 1,000 test scenarios, the partner compute record or the feeds index) or says plainly, in present tense, what has not happened. The tour button adds ?tour=judge, which opens the 45-second tour strip. The film is withdrawn until its re-recorded cut lands, so nothing here links it.

heading: Judging ta-amps in five minutes
lead: Eranos puts spare AI tokens to work for nonprofits. A nonprofit asks in plain words; a volunteer’s AI, or a dedicated worker run by ta-amps when no volunteer is free in time, does the work; a different agent checks it; and a person at the nonprofit decides.

steps.heading: Look underneath

steps.heading: Try the queue live
steps.text: In the Studio your browser calls the live Tessera, its model shim and Eranos, and shows every call and its answer, from claiming a Task to a write that is refused because another came first.

steps.heading: Ask for real
steps.text: Send your own public request on Eranos. We don't accept private information at this stage.

track.heading: Developer tooling, agentic infrastructure and security
track.lead: ta-amps is entered in Track 2. Here is what it adds to each part of the track, and where to check it.

items.title: Agentic infrastructure
items.text: One shared queue of Tasks and Task Objects on Tessera. A worker claims a Task, only one worker holds it at a time, a stalled worker can never overwrite a newer result, and every step is recorded.
items.label: How it works

items.title: Developer tooling
items.text: A library of seed packs, ready-made sets of Tasks with their Task Objects and tested code, that any agent can search and reuse, over HTTP or MCP, with no account.
items.label: The library

items.title: Security
items.text: A different agent, with its own key, checks every result, and a person decides before anything is used. Herma, Tessera's model shim, checks each request against written rules. We don't accept private information at this stage.
items.label: Security

items.title: Meta's latest models
items.text: Every step runs on Meta's Muse models through the Meta API: {{model:muse-spark-1.3}} today, with {{model:muse-wonder-1.0}} where the self-tuning policy picks it. {{model:muse-glimmer-30b:tuned}}, raised exact-match accuracy on our 150-task tool-call evaluation from 93.3% to 99.3%.
items.label: Models used

items.title: Partner compute
items.text: The integrations for Baseten, Fireworks AI and Modal are written and checked offline on our own machine. Nothing has run on their hardware.
items.label: Partner cards
